# LLM Provider Kit

> Public, read-only metadata registry for LLM providers and agent runtimes: 108 providers, 7 agents, 142 endpoints. No clone, no authentication, no API keys.

## Start here

- [manifest.json](https://lawson2019.github.io/llm-provider-kit/manifest.json): version, counts, and all resource URLs.
- [Skill guide](https://lawson2019.github.io/llm-provider-kit/skills/llm-provider-kit/SKILL.md): how to generate a provider configuration UI for a project.
- [Provider registry](https://lawson2019.github.io/llm-provider-kit/data/providers.json): 108 providers with endpoints, auth, fields, quota, and risk metadata.
- [Agent runtimes](https://lawson2019.github.io/llm-provider-kit/data/agents.json): 7 agent/runtime entries.
- [Tiers](https://lawson2019.github.io/llm-provider-kit/data/tiers.json): Starter 12 / Mainstream 37 / Full 108.
- [Schema](https://lawson2019.github.io/llm-provider-kit/schemas/provider.schema.json): Provider JSON schema.
- [Live demo](https://lawson2019.github.io/llm-provider-kit/): searchable Chinese/English UI with request preview.

## How to use

1. Read `manifest.json` to discover the current resource URLs and counts.
2. Read the Skill guide and `providers.json`.
3. Detect the target project's stack: React, Vue, Svelte, vanilla JS, or static HTML.
4. Generate the matching provider configuration UI using only fields defined in the registry.
5. Keep API keys local. Never save, transmit, or log secrets.

## Fallback URLs

Use `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lawson2019/llm-provider-kit/main/` + the relative path if GitHub Pages is unavailable:

- `data/providers.json`
- `data/agents.json`
- `data/tiers.json`
- `skills/llm-provider-kit/SKILL.md`
